entities.summary: The St. James Cathedral Also Saltillo Cathedral Is the catholic cathedral of the city of Saltillo in Mexico. It is the tallest cathedral in the north of Mexico, and the 2nd tallest in the country with a height of 81m. The cathedral is located in the historical center of the city, opposite the Plaza de Armas, is one of the architectural jewels of the state of Coahuila.
